text:
sam: quick RFC follow-up: propose a small 'hot-runway' compact-on-write to reduce long-term fragmentation for large shards
carla: short: sample hot byte ranges, cluster them into a runway, and on writes to cold ranges do bounded micro-compactions into the runway
marta: how small is 'bounded'? we need strict SLO guarantees for tail latency
sam: default sync budget 2ms per write; if exceeded we enqueue rest to async worker and let the write proceed with old mapping until publish
jiro: allocator integration concerns: remap must be atomic for KV/pin pointers
marta: use the descriptor+epoch publish model: allocate staging, copy, publish new descriptor atomically, free old pages after epoch drain
carla: staging headroom and noisy neighbors?
sam: ephemeral per-node runway pool (config 2-3% mem) tagged by tenant. per-tenant compaction credits throttle work and show in telemetry/billing
jiro: eviction interplay 14 could compact then immediately evict
sam: sampler increases hotness weight for compacted pages; compaction clusters hot pages to increase residency probability
marta: failure modes: mid-copy crash should be safe
sam: we never publish until full copy done; partial copies cleaned up. compactor writes a tiny journal for recovery
infra-bot: created issue RUNTIME-8001: "hot-runway compact-on-write PoC" and linked this thread :robot_face:
carla: rollout: sampler-only telemetry first (2w), opt-in compaction, then ramp with kill-switches
sam: i'll open a tiny sampler PR and perf harness link later today. :thumbsup:
